attack_parameters.description: Scenario 3 includes two sub-scenarios using broadcast (true) ephemerides with no jamming. (1) 2.2.3: Incoherent position jump to the cemetery. (2) 2.3.3: Coherent position jump to the north end of the football field. Both sub-scenarios spoof GPS L1/L2/L5 and Galileo E1/E5a/E5b signals with a fixed power of 0.316 W. Start times are referenced to live GPS signals.
